title: Anomaly Investigation: 35% Mobile Checkout Drop
problem_brief: Yesterday's daily executive briefing showed total checkout conversion dropped from 4.8% to 3.1% week-over-week. The VP of Growth believes user sentiment dropped following a pricing change. Dive into the segmented dataset, device breakdowns, and event instrumentation to test the hypothesis and uncover the true driver.

entries.error: Crash report: checkout sheet terminated unexpectedly on ApplePay button touch.

submission_fields.label: 1. Executive Summary (BLUF: Bottom Line Up Front)
submission_fields.placeholder: Summarize the findings in 2-3 sentences for leadership...
submission_fields.guidance: State clearly whether the VP's pricing hypothesis is supported or refuted.

submission_fields.label: 2. Segmented Analysis & Root Cause Evidence
submission_fields.placeholder: Break down the numbers proving where the conversion drop originated...
submission_fields.guidance: Contrast Desktop/Android vs iOS v4.3 Apple Pay crash data.

submission_fields.label: 3. Immediate Actionable Recommendations
submission_fields.placeholder: What should the mobile engineering and product teams do immediately?
submission_fields.guidance: e.g., App Store emergency hotfix, fallback payment method, banner notice.

submission_fields.label: 4. Telemetry & Quality Guardrails
submission_fields.placeholder: How should automated funnel alerts and release health monitoring be improved?
submission_fields.guidance: Suggest release staging cohorts and anomaly threshold alerting.

dimensions.name: Hypothesis Refutation & Rigor
dimensions.criteria: Refutes the pricing change theory with data (pricing affected all platforms, but only iOS v4.3 experienced a drop).

dimensions.name: Segmented Data Accuracy
dimensions.criteria: Directly quotes conversion rates across Desktop (stable at ~5%), Android (stable at ~4.3%), and iOS v4.3 (crashed to 0.4%).

dimensions.name: Technical Root Cause Identification
dimensions.criteria: Connects the drop to the ApplePay crash on postal code nil unwrapping in iOS release v4.3.

dimensions.name: Communication & Actionability
dimensions.criteria: Presents clear, concise guidance for the mobile release engineering team and executive leadership.
